system.description:
The spell creates a large shield (half the size of a human; see the Creature Size section on page 95 of Game Master Guide) of compressed air, which lowers all damage of ranged attacks by -1 (P rotection Value 1). The spell is woven over a place touched by the enchanter, from which the shield rises straight up. The shield is static and cannot be moved. Any ranged weapons with Penetration Value apply the value to this shield as well. If the shield of compressed air is made so large that it covers a whole being, it might prevent anyone from charging through it.
